name: exyokioffice
description: C++20 library for reading, writing and editing Office Open XML documents

ExyokiOffice reads and writes Word, Excel and PowerPoint packages through a generated, typed OOXML DOM, high-level document editors, an OPC packaging layer, package and DOM validation, digital signatures, and format conversion. It has no external dependencies.

mcp.description: Build the exyoki Word, Excel and PowerPoint MCP servers
